Welcome—I'm really glad you're here.
Have you ever wondered how a single moment in history can shape the course of an entire life?
Together, we're about to step into the world of Parallel Journeys by Eleanor H. Ayer, a story where two young lives—one swept up in the Hitler Youth, the other fighting to survive as a Jewish girl—unfold against the backdrop of Nazi Germany.
What’s truly remarkable is how their journeys, even though divided by beliefs and circumstance, are tied together by the powerful currents of their time.
We’ll see how choices, identity, and moments of awakening take shape under pressure, and how ordinary people are pulled into the machinery of war, often forced to question everything they thought they knew.
As we walk alongside these two, we’ll notice stark differences, but also surprising connections—glimpses into the broader human experience during the Holocaust.
Get ready to explore moments of indoctrination, resistance, loss, and hope. Through their eyes, we’ll discover what it means to be resilient and how history leaves its mark on each of us.
So, let’s begin this journey together, opening ourselves to empathy, courage, and a deeper search for meaning—even when the world seems turned upside down.
